page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre; page number top left; catchword at bottom right ("termi-"). Handwriting in the margins at top left is not transcribed.

main_text.p: gnus: vt discamus alacriter vires nostras experiri in aggrediendis Dei præceptis: nec occasionem prætermittere, ne cessantibus claudatur ianua. Reprehensione vacasset modica dilatio: sed longi temporis molities Dei benedictionem quodammodo repulit.
main_text.head: CAPVT XVI.
main_text.p: 1 Gressa est autem sors filiis Ioseph à Iordane Ieri cho, ad aquas Iericho, ad Orientem, ad desertum quod ascendit à Iericho in montem Beth-el.
2 Egreditúrque à Beth-el in Luz, & hinc pertransit ad terminum Archi Ataroth.
3 Postea ascendit ad mare, ad terminum Iaphleti, vsque ad terminũ Beth-horon inferiorem, & vsque ad Gazer, súntque exitus eius ad Mare.
4 Itaque hæreditatem acceperunt filii Ioseph, Manasses & Ephraim:
5 Fuit autem terminus filiorum Ephraim per familias suas: fuit inquam, termi-

page.notes: The initial E is a large woodcut ornamental initial. Marginal handwriting at top left is not transcribed. The catchword "termi-" is printed at bottom right.
